compliance_notes: Static consultation ads. SEC disclaimer REMOVED from ad copy per client (2026-08-11) — it lives on the destination website; do NOT re-append to primary_text on rebuild.
CFP always carries the registered mark (CFP®); CFA never does. No CFA reference in this set.
No urgency/scarcity, guarantees, or performance claims. HNW/UHNW signaled by situation (concentrated stock, business sale, equity comp, multi-generational wealth), never a dollar minimum.
Estate demoted to one capability inside coordination (rebalanced 2026-08-11). CTA: Request a Consultation.
